title: Comfort Club Covered Repairs: Labor Valuation on Evening, Weekend, Overnight and Holiday Calls
content:
Under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, the repair labor a covered repair pays for is valued at the daytime labor price, whatever call class the repair was booked under. The call class is the class the member's completed call was booked as under Repair and Emergency Service Calls.

## Rule
- **Overnight Emergency Service Call or Holiday Emergency Service Call:** the repair labor billed on the call is valued by dividing it by the overnight and holiday labor multiplier of **1.5**, so the plan pays the daytime labor price.
- **Evening Service Call or Weekend Service Call:** the repair labor billed on the call is valued by dividing it by the evening and weekend labor multiplier of **1.25**.
- **Any other call class:** this rule does not change the labor value.

Each divided amount is rounded to the cent half up.

## Call class to multiplier

| Call class booked | Divided by | Labor valued at |
|---|---|---|
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 1.5 | billed labor divided by 1.5 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 1.5 | billed labor divided by 1.5 |
| Evening Service Call | 1.25 | billed labor divided by 1.25 |
| Weekend Service Call | 1.25 | billed labor divided by 1.25 |
| Any other call class | — | not changed by this rule |

## Examples (hypothetical labor amounts)
- Overnight Emergency call, repair labor billed 450.00: 450.00 divided by 1.5 gives 300.00.
- Holiday Emergency call, repair labor billed 200.00: 200.00 divided by 1.5 is 133.333..., rounded half up to 133.33.
- Weekend call, repair labor billed 312.50: 312.50 divided by 1.25 gives 250.00.
- Evening call, repair labor billed 100.00: 100.00 divided by 1.25 gives 80.00.

## Basis questions
**Does the division touch the parts lines?** No — only the repair labor of the call is divided.
